basis: S5b-1: a material's product is decided from the clause filing code its terms print and the full product name its title carries (checked on 39 materials of 13 products, 2026-10-24). Product types follow the filed name suffix after trailing qualifiers such as (分红型) are removed; 养老年金 is an annuity (user 2026-10-18). New products get an id generated from the clause filing code (user 2026-10-24). 2026-10-24.2 (review R3): a clause code starts with a listed issuer, so a label printed before it is never taken into the code. 2026-10-25.1 (review R3 remainder): only the material's own code — at the very start, followed by the title — may create a product or make a new version; a code elsewhere (after a label, or cited in the body) only confirms a registered product whose name the title carries. 2026-10-26.4 (S5b-5, review R1-R3 and the R2 remainders on PR #355): real on-sale terms do not open with their code; each prints its own code once on page 1, followed by the QR verification line, so that line marks the own code anywhere in the first two pages (checked on 20 terms of 20 products). The title is read at the start after stripping page numbers and 险种简称/险种代码 labels repeatedly; only when the start has none does the reader guide (阅读指引…产品提供) stand in, and only for terms, with one guide starting in the first anchor_chars, every guide naming the same product, and no code, verification line or title end word in the name, each guide read whole up to the next guide so an overlong or empty one is checked rather than skipped; otherwise there is no title. The start title is never checked against the guide, which some extractors garble. Every parenthesised qualifier is ignored when the type suffix is read, so 平安意外(A款)医疗保险 is accident medical. 专属商业养老保险 is supplementary pension (user 2026-10-26). 2026-10-31.1 (S11c): sales and training materials, and Office files of no recognised role, often print only a product's brand; when neither the clause code nor a whole title anchors them, the registered products whose brand core (the name without the 平安/附加 prefixes, every parenthesised qualifier and the type suffix) starts with the first brand_min_chars characters the material's file name or opening carries are offered to a person, narrowed to the products of a year the material carries when any match; a brand is never an anchor, so even one candidate is a question, and none or more than brand_max_candidates leave the material quarantined. 2026-11-01.1 (S5b-7, batch 1 of 2026-10-31): extraction follows the PDF content stream, so rate tables carry their title line (《<name>》年交费率表, …保障成本表, …基本保险金额表) at the end of page 1, and some brochures open with the insurer's name above a title split over two lines. A whole title line anywhere in the first pages — the bracketed name followed only by one listed qualifier (年交, 年保障, 基本保险, …, as found on the 981 on-sale PDFs) and one listed document word, with no explanation or negation word (不适用, 并非, 参见, …) — or a bracketed-name line followed by such words on the next line, confirms the registered product it names exactly; it never creates a product or a new version, title lines of different products are a conflict unless at least two are registered, and its document words add to the opening's role signals (a conflict between them stays a conflict). The insurer's name is skipped before the start title like a label, and empty 险种简称/险种代码 labels are labels too (before, a terms whose labels are blank took them for its title). 2026-11-01.2 (PV-1, PV-0 §4.2 and appendix A §1.3): a filed version is the unit; new terms of a registered name (own code not among its codes) are a NEW_VERSION that adds a new entry beside it (same id rule as a created product, the registered entry kept as the candidate, nothing replaced or retired), instead of replacing its terms in the same entry. With the pinned version catalog a v2 registry names, a clause code is matched to a filed version first: the entry holding that version key, unless the code also names another entry (a conflict); a code several filed versions share is quarantined before anything is created; a code held by one entry whose version key differs is a conflict; otherwise the earlier rules apply and a new entry carries the version key. Clause codes compare in one form everywhere (folded, ASCII brackets as 〔〕); registered values are kept as confirmed. 2026-11-01.3 (PV-3, Option A, user 2026-11-01): in a v2 registry a sales or training material that no clause code or title anchors is matched by its brand and its own date signals (file name, opening, whole date lines; year, month or day precision; a coarser date inside a finer one is not counted again; amounts, filing-code years and years outside the range are no dates) to the registered versions: the whole candidate set is computed first (a version's year tag equals the material's year, or its sale period overlaps the material's period), versions whose explicit plan type, rider status or edition the material's type words contradict are shown but never candidates; exactly one candidate, consistent (a month or day falls wholly inside its known sale period; a year needs only the overlap or the tag), settles it as a machine decision; dates that do not nest leave only ignoring; no date lets a person choose a type-consistent version of the family; a material naming two families or none is quarantined. Training words give the training role only when no other role shows any signal. Channels and 税优 are not type words: the versions carry no reliable marker for them. 2026-11-01.4 (PV-3 review R1-R3, R5 on PR #506): a family is the widest brand-core prefix the material names, so two families sharing a short prefix but named apart are two families (quarantined), and a family named alone does not drag in another; amounts (currency, units) and bracketed reference numbers are masked before dates are read; 普通型 is an explicit plan type too; an edition the material names explicitly (in brackets or right after the brand) contradicts every version not of that edition, registered or not; a version without its external key is shown but never a target, automatic or chosen; the training fallback sees title-line role signals too.
